target.title: fix(openai): repair stale doctor route pins
target.body:
Closes #101672

AI-assisted.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users whose sessions automatically fell back to canonical `openai` could keep stale OpenAI model/provider routing state after running `openclaw doctor --fix --deep`, because doctor had no OpenAI session-route owner for the literal `openai` provider id.

## Why This Change Was Made

This uses the existing plugin doctor contract seam instead of adding a new repair path: the OpenAI plugin now declares ownership of canonical `openai` session route state, while Codex keeps ownership of legacy Codex ids such as `openai-codex`. The generic session-route repair also clears fallback-origin provenance when it clears an auto model override, so doctor does not leave stale provenance after reporting the route state repaired.

## User Impact

Operators can expect `doctor --fix --deep` to detect and clear stale auto-created `openai` session route pins after defaults move back to a non-OpenAI primary, without hand-patching installed plugin files or manually editing session JSON. Explicit/user model choices still go through the existing manual-review path rather than being silently cleared.

## Evidence

- `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passed after one initial 120s timeout and retry.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-session-state-providers.test.ts extensions/openai/doctor-contract-api.test.ts` passed: 2 Vitest shards, 14 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/doctor-contract-registry.test.ts` passed: 1 shard, 13 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/bundled-plugin-metadata.test.ts test/scripts/bundled-plugin-build-entries.test.ts` passed: 2 shards, 52 tests.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/commands/doctor-session-state-providers.ts src/commands/doctor-session-state-providers.test.ts extensions/openai/doctor-contract-api.ts extensions/openai/doctor-contract-api.test.ts` passed.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor-session-state-providers.ts src/commands/doctor-session-state-providers.test.ts extensions/openai/doctor-contract-api.ts extensions/openai/doctor-contract-api.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` passed: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
- A prior `codex review --base upstream/main` finding about fallback-origin fields was accepted; the fix now clears `modelOverrideFallbackOriginProvider` and `modelOverrideFallbackOriginModel`, and the focused tests were rerun.
- Upstream Codex source checked locally: `codex-rs/model-provider-info/src/lib.rs` defines `OPENAI_PROVIDER_ID` as `openai`, builds the built-in OpenAI provider with Responses wire API and OpenAI auth, includes `openai` in built-in providers, and merges user-configured providers without replacing the built-in `openai` entry.

What was not tested: a live paid-provider doctor run against a production session store; the regression is covered at the doctor contract and session-route repair layers without using external credentials.
